about.headline: Full-stack leadership across product UI, APIs, and platform architecture.
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Software Developer with 8+ years building and leading work on enterprise web products. My sweet spot is owning the full path — frontend architecture, APIs, data-heavy UIs, and the decisions that keep systems fast and maintainable as they grow.

At Yum! Brands I lead design and delivery of production platforms used at scale: Server-Driven UI systems, real-time dashboards, and analytics surfaces over million-row datasets. I partner closely with product, data science, and engineering — and I mentor through reviews, design discussions, and clear technical direction.

Before that I shipped B2B commerce frontends and full-stack features in Node and Angular. Today I also bring AI into real workflows — agents, RAG, and automation — without turning the product into a science project.

usecases.title: Enterprise Analytics at Scale
usecases.problem: Decision makers needed interactive analytics over millions of marketing and operational records without sacrificing responsiveness.
usecases.solution: Designed high-performance React dashboards with virtualization, server-side pagination, and disciplined state architecture.
usecases.outcome: Smooth exploration of 1M+ records with maintainable UI systems used across enterprise workflows.

usecases.title: Configurable Enterprise UI Platform
usecases.problem: Shipping new workflows required frequent frontend redeploys and duplicated UI logic across teams.
usecases.solution: Built a Server-Driven UI platform where JSON schemas define screens, forms, permissions, and actions.
usecases.outcome: Faster feature delivery with RBAC-aware personalization and a live studio for schema debugging.

usecases.title: B2B E-commerce Frontend Modernization
usecases.problem: High-traffic buyer–seller flows suffered from inconsistent UI and slow page loads.
usecases.solution: Engineered a scalable frontend architecture and reusable component library with performance-focused delivery.
usecases.outcome: Faster pages, consistent UX, and higher engineering velocity for product teams.

usecases.title: AI-Assisted Automation Workflows
usecases.problem: Manual operational workflows slowed teams and buried useful insights in raw data.
usecases.solution: Integrated OpenAI APIs and agent-style automation into production applications alongside existing platforms.
usecases.outcome: Automated repetitive work and unlocked faster insight loops for business stakeholders.
